description: Figure 9 presents two bar charts that evaluate the performance of the proposed models against the LLaMA-3-8B-it baseline on a range of academic and practical benchmarks. The top chart, titled "Comprehensive Evaluation Results on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," compares four models: LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue), Ours (SFT baseline) (orange), Ours (DPO baseline) (green), and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (red). The x-axis lists the datasets and metrics, including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The y-axis represents the score in percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. The results show that the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model generally achieves the highest scores across most benchmarks, particularly on GSM-8K, MMLU, and HumanEval, where it outperforms the LLaMA-3-8B-it baseline. The bottom chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," provides a more focused comparison between LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue) and the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model (orange). This chart confirms the superior performance of the proposed model, with the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" consistently achieving higher scores than LLaMA-3-8B-it across all evaluated datasets and metrics.
